bounded_context_cards.title: The Clock Strikes
bounded_context_cards.body: The Doomsday Clock reaches one. There are no more options. Only fire.

sample_reactions: The Wali's last fatwa is transmitted by emergency broadcast: 'The Mahdi is not in the servers. He is in the fire.'

bounded_context_cards.title: The Census of Believers
bounded_context_cards.body: Ten years after the Kalam Republic. Ninety percent of China passes the annual kalam exam. The Atheist runs the grading algorithm. He has never scored above sixty percent.

bounded_context_cards.title: Ending - The Kalam Republic
bounded_context_cards.body: China becomes a Mu'tazili rationalist state with Pentagon-grade supply chains. Military compute priority is law. Yudkowsky is cited in footnotes but explicitly not fully heeded. The peasants comply, but the mystic heart is silent.
